decision_maker: validation: decisions copied from the 2026-10 large run
request: Re-run PMID41787055 through tools/case_runner.py with its recorded decisions

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of prostate tumor tissue, HiSeq 3000 50 bp SE, TopHat (mm9) + HTSeq-count (S4.6.p1, S4.7.p1, DA.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: tumors from 3 representative animals per group (control, exercise, Phellodendron amurense extract) (S2.2.p1, S4.6.p1)
final.sample_exclusion: one exercise mouse died in week 8 (excluded from the study, S2.1.p1); selection rule for the 3 sequenced 'representative' tumors not reported

factors.name: intervention
levels: exercise (single housed, voluntary wheel running, 12 wk)
Phellodendron amurense extract (PhAm/Nexrutine, 600 mg/kg in AIN-93 diet, group housed)

planned_contrasts: PhAm vs control (S2.2.p2; paper: 176 DEGs, 76 up / 100 down)

blocking_or_covariance.note: independent animals, one tumor each; no batch reported

final.matrix_scale: HTSeq raw read counts per gene (S4.7.p1)
final.paper_method: R package DESeq, group-pairwise differential expression (S4.7.p1)

paper_threshold.expression_filter: at least one sample type with mean RPKM > 1
paper_threshold.also_stated: ABS.p1 '>= 1.5-fold change, adjusted p < 0.05'; S2.2.p1 'adj p < 0.05 and +/-1.5-fold'

final.pathway_analysis: GO biological process / molecular function and gene-set enrichment of DEGs (FIG3C-D, FIG4C-D); tool not named

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S4.2.p1 randomizes male TRAMP mice to control, exercise (wheel) and PhAm diet for 12 weeks; S4.6.p1 sequences 3 tumors per group; S4.7.p1 gives HTSeq counts, DESeq group-pairwise tests, RPKM>1 + FDR<0.05 + FC>1.5. S2.2.p1 reports 32 exercise-vs-control DEGs; DA.p1 names GSE293221.

checks.data_processing: TopHat v2.0.8 to mm9, HTSeq-count (matches S4.7.p1)

ownership.reasoning: DA.p1 names GSE293221; 9 GSMs = Control/Exercise/Nexrutine x 3 from TRAMP prostate tumor, TopHat+HTSeq, as in S4.6.p1 and S4.7.p1.

alignment.reasoning: Each per-sample file name starts with its GSM id, which equals the metadata index; exact alignment, 9/9. grp derived from title and checked against the treatment characteristic.

matrix.reasoning: Non-negative integers from HTSeq-count with __no_feature/__ambiguous summary rows; matches the paper's DESeq input.

contrasts.name: grp_PHAM_vs_CON
contrasts.role: paper's second planned contrast (S2.2.p2); not an exercise effect

final.sex_check: all 9 predicted male from X/Y genes; paper: male TRAMP mice
final.sensitivity: all three comparisons also extracted from one DESeq2 model ~ grp on all 9 samples (tools.joint_contrasts), labelled sensitivity/exploratory
